address: 6F, Four Seasons Hotel, 8 Finance Street, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: One of Hong Kong's most glamorous and elegant restaurants, Caprice also boasts impressive harbour views and always delivers an amazing experience. The harmonious, high-calibre French cuisine features premium ingredients, demonstrates superb techniques and shows a mastery of flavours. Only prix-fixe menus are served: four or five courses at lunch, and two seven-course options at dinner. Check out the stunning wine list and dazzling selection of cheeses....
